voci.titolo: Private sector jobs rose by 90,000 in September, better than expected, ADP reports
voci.riassunto: Private job creation picked up in September after a brief slowdown.

voci.titolo: Consumer optimism slides to lowest since 2014 as fears escalate over rising prices and jobs
